one_line: One tip per shot, a bold key word flashed on each, and a comment word that delivers a checklist.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a young woman smiles over a purple pencil case held at chin level, school supplies on the table. Text box: "טיפים לארגון הקלמר ולציוד מומלץ ממאיה מרפאה בעיסוק לילדים" and bold "קלמר חכם". Said (transcript): "קלמר חכם, כללים".
q1_hook.why: A face, a voice, a product in hand and a headline with a credential from frame zero (H1, H4, S1, T3, H6). "Smart pencil case" names a seasonal task parents face (K6, K7). The promise of tips is generic, with no result stated, and the text box covers her chin and the case (H2, F2).

beats.what: Smiling over a purple case; headline text box; then two cases and Giotto boxes on a grey table
beats.why: A credential and the first picture of the kit.

beats.what: Hands turn a case; she holds up three fingers; "שלושה תאים נפרדים"; a two-compartment case, "שני תאים"
Pencils with erasers; a pencil test on lined paper; erasers; a sharpener sharpens a pencil
beats.why: Each item is a new shot and a new key word.

beats.what: A ruler, a glue stick, left and right scissors; "ובתא האחרון והכיפי"
beats.why: The rest of the kit, one object per shot.

beats.what: Markers and crayon boxes held up; a shop shelf at 0:46; "לגיאוטו הכי רחב והכי איכותי"
beats.why: A change of place and the brand claim.

beats.what: She draws a name on the case with textile markers, then colours it; "יחד עם הילד לא בשבילו"
beats.why: A fun extra and a closing principle.

beats.what: Holds two printed checklists; a hand ticks one; "תכתבו ״קלמר״ בתגובות ותקבלו את הצ'ק ליסט"
beats.why: The ask, with the offer visible.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen 1:01 to 1:05 and in the caption: write "קלמר" in the comments to get the checklist. A save is not asked for, nor a send to a parent.
q2_flow.why: A new picture every 2 s, one item and one bold key word per shot, gives a tip list a clear pulse (R3, E2, F8), and a checklist is the gift at the end (R6). The shop shot and the decorated name break the pattern (R3). At 65 s with about ten items it is dense (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: On screen 1:01 to 1:05 (a box): "תכתבו ״קלמר״ בתגובות ותקבלו את הצ'ק ליסט לארגון הקלמר 👇", then "תכתבי את המילה ואשלח לך". Said (transcript): "תכתבי את המילה קלמר ואשלח לך". Caption: the same, last line.
q3_cta.why: One ask in voice, text and caption, a named keyword with a real, specific reward, after the value has been shown (C1, C3, C6, R6). The box sits in the bottom 35%. The word is a generic product word, and the caption's first line repeats nothing about it (F2, C6).

q4_shown.what: Two pencil cases and a purple one with a coloured name from 0:02; Giotto and Lyra boxes, pencils, erasers, sharpeners, a ruler, glue, scissors, markers, each in hand; a shop shelf at 0:46; textile markers; a ticked checklist. No child or price.
q4_shown.why: Every item is held, named and shown being used, so each tip is checkable (S1, F8, K5), with a credentialed first-person verdict, "אני ממליצה" (S6). Giotto is one of several brands, named only at 0:45 (H3, C7). No child appears (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 31 shots in 64.8 s, 2.1 s average, straight cuts at each item. She is on camera only at 0:00 to 0:13, 0:18 and 0:58; top-down hands carry the rest. Voiceover wall to wall, one to three bold words. Ends on the checklist.
q5_edit.why: A cut for each item, a new object every 2 s, keeps a long list moving (E2, R3, F8). The voice and big key words work with sound on or off (E4, T1, T2). It ends right after the ask (E8), but at 65 s it is long (R2).

q6_topic.what: How to choose and fill a first-grader's pencil case, item by item, from an occupational therapist; a free checklist is offered. Serves a parent shopping for school.
q6_topic.why: The school start is a dated shopping moment and a real concern (K7, K6). Each tip is practical, modest and delivered warmly (K4), and a checklist is exactly what a parent would save or send to another parent (R7, R5). No peak emotion (K1).

q7_filmed.what: A medium shot at eye level in a bright kitchen for the opening and a few returns; static top-down phone shots on a grey counter for the tips, with close-ups of hands; a wide shop shot at 0:46. Daylight.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands on a plain counter make every item large and readable (F5, F4, S4), the pause to the lens gives a human anchor (F6), and daylight at home looks native (H8, F7). Full 9:16, sharp (F1, F3). The key words at about 78% are in the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: A semi-transparent box 0:00 to 0:03: "טיפים לארגון הקלמר ולציוד מומלץ ממאיה מרפאה בעיסוק לילדים". Large bold white words, one to three at a time, at about 78% down, a key word enlarged: "קלמר חכם" (0:00), "עפרונות" (0:13), "מחק" (0:18), "מחדד" (0:24), "שני" (0:31), "ובתא" (0:37), "לגיאוטו" (0:45). From 1:01 a CTA box with "קלמר".
q8_text.caption: "טיפים לארגון את הקלמר". About 190 words: "המלצות של מרפאה בעיסוק", the compartments and items in order, tips, the checklist offer, "כתבי את המילה ״קלמר״ ואשלח לך" last. No hashtags, no partnership word, a tag @giotto_israel mid-text.
q8_text.why: Short, large words with an enlarged key word read at a glance and work muted (T2, T1, T5), but they sit in the bottom 35% (T4, F2). The caption has product, occasion and topic words in a list (T7), but the Giotto partnership is not stated in words anywhere (S7, T8).

weak_points: No stated partnership in words; the brand claim is one line at 0:45 among Lyra items; 65 s; key words in the bottom band; a text box over her chin and the case at 0:00; no hashtags.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a top-down tip per shot with one bold key word each, end with a checklist-style freebie for a comment word, in about 30 s.
not_verified: Whether the partnership was paid (a co-author is listed, no label, only a tag in the caption); the checklist contents beyond the frames; some voiceover words (the transcript is partial); music (none evident). A name is written on the sample case, not quoted here. Corrections to the first pass: the checklist offer is also a text box at about 80% down from 1:01 to 1:05; the name on the case is coloured in at 0:49 to 0:58. Plays 8,426, likes 89, comments 118 on 15 Oct are context only. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
